Theorem
[Anderson's fundamental-group finiteness theorem]

Source: petersen:page-0309 ↗ def:pet-ch7-manifold-class ↗ lem:pet-ch7-gromov-generators 1. ch7:7.2.3For fixed $n,k,v,D$, there are only finitely many isomorphism types of fundamental group among the manifolds in $\mathfrak {M}(n,k,v,D)$.
Proof

↗ thm:pet-ch7-anderson-finiteness ↗ lem:pet-ch7-gromov-generators ↗ lem:pet-ch7-absolute-volume-comparison \sketch Use short generators and a Dirichlet fundamental domain $F$ in the universal cover. The translates of $F$ associated to distinct generators are disjoint and lie in $B(x,6D)$. Absolute volume comparison bounds their number by $v(n,k,6D)/v$, so only finitely many relation presentations occur.

□
